records.question: 2025年华东地区各品类销售额
records.sql: SELECT "products"."category", "regions"."region_name", SUM("order_items"."line_amount") AS "销售额" FROM "order_items" JOIN "orders" ON "order_items"."order_id" = "orders"."order_id" JOIN "products" ON "order_items"."product_id" = "products"."product_id" JOIN "regions" ON "orders"."region_id" = "regions"."region_id" WHERE "orders"."order_date" >= ? AND "orders"."order_date" < ? AND "regions"."region_name" = ? GROUP BY "products"."category", "regions"."region_name" ORDER BY SUM("order_items"."line_amount") DESC LIMIT ?
